release.content: pubdeploy 0.6.1 was released on 2026-11-20 from commit 740db511e1a3d466b1e71bc54c1654ad2feede41 with these changes.

rows: pubdeploy.contract: the provider contract as code. CONTEXT, NEED, RESULT, RESULT_OPTIONAL, TYPE and TYPE_OPTIONAL are the names a provider may rely on, equal to README's "Provider contract" lists; Need, Result and Ran come from it; problems(kind) and hook_problems(hook) say what the walk says of a type or a hook it leaves out (registry.type_problems is now contract.problems). A provider's tests import pubdeploy.contract and pubdeploy.testing, and nothing else of pubdeploy

pubdeploy.testing: World.providers() gives the sustenaut.needs entry points and sustenaut.walk hooks the walk loads in the world, together as a Providers, in place of the installed packages' (None, the default, keeps them); walk_needs(world, needs, types, fulfil) walks needs in the world's context and gives the deploy-journal/2 document as data
The suite walks with a stand-in provider built from pubdeploy.contract alone, and no longer installs pubsec: the scenarios that tested pubsec's own types are pubsec's
